description_en: Sets the X.509 certificate information for a product
description_zh: 调用该接口设置产品的X.509证书信息
name: SetProductCertInfo

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>instance ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The certificate issuance mode. Valid values:

1: X.509 certificates are issued by IoT Platform.

3: X.509 certificates are issued by a third-party platform
parameters.help_zh:
证书颁发模式。

1：由物联网平台颁发X.509证书。

3：由第三方平台颁发X.509证书
